title: Cowpea (Veg): modeled ₹582/qtl left, Palayam → Kayamkulam
summary: February 2022: reported cowpea (Veg) prices at Palayam and Kayamkulam imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 83% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹582 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 252 same-variety market pairs screened for cowpea (Veg) in February 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kayamkulam report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2022
scenes.caption: Palayam (Kerala) and Kayamkulam (Kerala) both reported cowpea (Veg) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Palayam reported a median ₹2,500 per quintal. Kayamkulam reported a median ₹3,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,000 per quintal, and Kayamkulam was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 269 km by road
scenes.caption: 269 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~5 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹58/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹603 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹452 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kayamkulam report, the rule selects 22 of 23 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹582 per quintal (₹381 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Cowpea (Veg) route from Palayam to Kayamkulam was positive on 83% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹58,200, or ₹38,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to cowpea (Veg)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹58/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Cowpea (Veg) route from Palayam to Kayamkulam was positive on 83% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹58,200, or ₹38,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
